meta.title: Launch film
meta.description: A 45 s launch film for tramme, made in tramme: a ball on the beat, kinetic type, the document, modifiers, shaders, particles, a 2.5D camera, nested compositions, sound-reactive motion, the assistant, the mark. Music and sound written as code.
